findings.text: Companies House holds no insolvency record for this company.

Across the 2 current directors, 2 other companies were found (1 liquidation, 1 dissolved), which is a low-level red flag for directors linked to a company in an insolvency process.
Two individuals are registered as persons with significant control, PERSON 233 and PERSON 234, each holding 25 to 50 percent of shares and voting rights and the right to appoint and remove directors.
The company has 1 satisfied charge registered and no outstanding or part-satisfied charges.
No registered office address changes or officer appointments or resignations have been filed since 24 October 2025.
